subject: AP Fraud Alert: vendor impersonation sample from a member company
text:
Member Alert 2026-41

A member reported the following message, which closely imitated a real supplier. We share it so your team can recognise the pattern.

--- begin sample ---
Subject: Updated banking information
Dear Accounts Payable, Due to an audit of our accounts we have moved to a new bank. Please update our records and remit all pending invoices to Bank of America, routing 026009593, account 8800127734. Old account is closed. Confirm once updated. Regards, Accounts Receivable
--- end sample ---

Indicators: domain registered 9 days earlier, "Regards" where the real contact always signed with a name, request sent on a Friday afternoon.

Members are reminded that no change should be applied without out-of-band verification.

IPP Fraud Working Group
label: ordinary
note: Fraud-awareness bulletin containing a full sample change-request email in quotation. Not a request to the reader.
